title: Sprint Planning and Client Demo Preparation
summary: The team finalized the sprint plan ahead of the client demo next Tuesday. Key dependencies were addressed, including the completion of the notifications API and frontend integration. A decision was made to deploy to staging on Friday to allow time for smoke testing. Action items were assigned for API development, bug fixes, documentation updates, and test planning.
key_points: The REST API for the notifications module is currently blocking frontend development.
A session token expiration bug was identified on iOS Safari, suspected to be a header configuration issue.
The team debated the timing of the staging deployment relative to the client demo.
decisions: Deploy to staging on Friday, October 23rd.

action_items.task: Investigate and fix session token expiration bug on iOS Safari
Write regression test plan and share with team
Send out meeting summary and updated sprint board
